notes.title: 2025 Flat Edition!
notes.notes:
Brand new update for the new year!

Now you can play 4d chess without your headset. The "Flat Edition," is the same as VR 4d chess, but easier to jump into. Several gameplay improvements have also been included in the flat version.

You will be able to launch the standalone version, or the VR version. I love virtual reality and the reason why I published this game is because it works so well in that medium. Over two years later, I find myself using virtual reality less - so I decided to revamp the game and release a flat version, so more people can enjoy playing.

I want to thank everyone who made a purchase over the years - the fact that people are still interested in the game motivated me to push out this free update.

Happy Gaming!
-Ricky

notes.title: Oculus Support and Gameplay Improvements
notes.notes:
New Features
Support for Oculus devices
Add quickplay button in main menu
Original Soundtrack and Ambiance available
Option to swap between High/Low resolution chess models


Improvements
Button press instead of hold to bring up menu
Physical button to bring up gameplay menu
AI has bias to move pawns forward
Medium AI has faster move algorithm
Hidden easter egg

Bugfixes
Restarting timed game now works properly
Turned up exposure on "Malibu Beach" background
Fix bug when castling
